messages:
ashley: Quick broadcast: we've updated the Interactive Playground sandbox policy and telemetry defaults. This affects docs-embedded runners and the evals-runner integration. Please review before we flip to GA tomorrow.
greg: What are the principal changes? will any user data be sent externally by default?
ashley: TL;DR: runner now defaults to local-only execution in the browser for small snippets. Server-side evals and longer jobs run in sandboxed containers with telemetry opt-in. No user-provided prompts are sent to 3rd-party ML endpoints.
nora: Perf/UX note: server-side evals still available, but require explicit consent and a per-org config. We added a new toggle in Console: "Playground: Server Execution (requires consent)".
docs-bot: Draft published: https://internal.redwood.dev/docs/playground-sandbox-policy (build 4678 -> staging) :white_check_mark:
mike: For SDK teams: does this change impact the evals-runner API or instrumentation? will SDK calls need a new header for opt-in?
ashley: Yes. New header `X-RW-EVALS-CONSENT: true` for server-side eval submission. Also added telemetry flag `playground.execution.mode=local|server` and tags `playground.execution.consent`. We documented migration steps and sample curl: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/evals \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \ 
  -H "X-RW-EVALS-CONSENT: true" \ 
  -d '{"config":"..."}'
```

nora: Also added code samples for the JS SDK to gracefully fall back to local runner when consent is absent. Example: `if (!consent) useLocalRunner()` in the client.
compliance: We reviewed the telemetry wording for EU customers. Consent must be explicit and revocable; added a consent revocation API and retention policy (30 days for ephemeral traces).
mike: Ops: any rollout flags so infra can toggle server-exec for internal sandboxes during testing?
ashley: Added feature flag `playground.server_exec_enabled` in feature-gate. Default off for public, on for internal testing orgs. We'll monitor usage metrics and error rates (dashboard link in doc).
greg: One question: will existing embed consumers need to change CSP or iframe allowances?
ashley: Minor CSP note included: if you embed the server-run playground, update frame-ancestors to allow our staging domain. Example in docs.
docs-bot: Announcement draft saved: https://internal.redwood.dev/announcements/playground-policy-draft. Schedule: GA flip at 09:00 PT tomorrow with staged rollout.
nora: Added an FAQ entry: "How do I opt out of server-side evals?" with code and Console steps.
mike: Thanks. I'll coordinate infra canary and watch the error budget during the first 2 hours.
ashley: Appreciate the quick reviews. I'll post the announcement in #sdk-announcements and #docs in 1hr unless anyone raises a blocker. :rocket:
